name: gate
wording: A hold point at a handover: the work does not go past it without the operator's sign-off. The gates are a story's read-back, held by the architect; a story's plan read-back, held by the lead, which a task with no story skips unless the operator calls it; a pull request the operator reviews, held by the lead before it merges; release; a fork that is irreversible, about value or beyond the architect's competence; and any point the operator calls, stop included. At a gate its holder, the party whose handover it is, interrupts, unless the sign-off there is delegated. Pushing a branch or opening a pull request is never a gate, and between gates the agents work without checking in.
reason: A gate is a hold point, the place work does not pass without sign-off, and never the interrupt its holder makes there; the two are kept apart, and a delegated sign-off holds the work without interrupting anyone.
